title: 第1章 仙人之下我无敌第2章 抢银行没有技术含量
slug: 都市修仙五年下山就无敌
content_zh:
“宝贝徒儿。”
“师父求求你了，下山吧。”
昆仑山脉深处，一位容貌极美气质绝佳的女人坐在床边。
丰腴身段被一件红色宫裙包裹，身材如山峦般起伏诱人，那足以让所有女人嫉妒的美艳脸蛋儿满是哀求。
苏清欢苦苦哀求的男子叫做叶凡，脑袋正枕在她那双修长美腿上，惬意的眯着眼。
“当年你强行将我掳上山，现在想让我下山？门都没有。”
叶凡声音懒洋洋的，下巴一抬，苏清欢十分熟练的剥好一颗葡萄塞入叶凡口中，心中那叫一个后悔。
五年前。
苏清欢下山历练，意外发现叶凡竟是传说中的纯阳之体，而且没有师门传承，是一块极佳的璞玉，未来成就不可限量。
指望那不成器的女弟子光耀门楣是不可能了。
于是苏清欢打破玉女观不收男弟子的门规，想将叶凡收为关门弟子。
然而叶凡油盐不进，丝毫不向往问道长生，说什么跟女朋友考上了燕京大学，要去上学读书。
堂堂纯阳之体不修炼，反倒浪费时间去读书谈恋爱，这给苏清欢气的呀，强行将叶凡掳上山。
不听话？打！
不修炼？打！
想要跑？打！
从结果看，苏清欢做对了。
短短五年，被迫刻苦修炼的叶凡已经筑基巅峰，并将玉女观诸多祖师传下来的看家本领全部学会。
风水卜卦医术丹药，符箓阵法飞剑御物，叶凡都达到了青出于蓝而胜于蓝的地步。
在地下长眠的祖师们要是知道，肯定会激动到热泪盈眶。

但……
这亦是噩梦的开始。
过去五年尊师重道的叶凡，化身欺师灭祖的孽徒，把苏清欢当下人使唤。
短短一个月，让她这个师父又是端茶喂饭，又是唱曲跳舞，甚至暖床或洗澡都要伺候，期间少不得被欺负……
苏清欢何曾受过这种委屈！
逃，逃不掉。
打，打不过。
甚至每次反抗，都会被打屁股，每每想起此事苏清欢羞愤欲绝。
为了摆脱叶凡这个孽徒，苏清欢每日循循善诱，讲述下山的好处，可偏偏叶凡不肯走。
用他的话说：在玉女观有美女师父贴心伺候，皇帝老儿也不过如此。
苏清欢三十有五，是女人最有韵味的阶段，实在是怕叶凡禁不住诱惑，万一捅破那层窗户纸……
玉女观干脆改名欲女观得了！
苏清欢继续劝道：“叶凡啊，其实你还有个师姐，沉鱼落雁人间绝色，你下山去寻她吧。”
“师姐哪有师父香，今晚暖床时穿那件绣着鲤鱼的红肚兜，我喜欢吃鱼。”
“……”
苏清欢脸蛋发烫，你那是喜欢吃鱼么，我都不好意思点破你！
她装作楚楚可怜模样，开始打感情牌：“叶凡，记得你说过家里还有个妹妹，你上山五年她一定很担心你。”
“所以我更得感谢师父您，不仅我妹妹担心我，我女朋友肯定也恨死我了，说不定她现在已经跟别人结婚生子。”
叶凡越想越气，将师父拉到怀里就是一顿打屁股，疼的苏清欢是敢怒不敢言。
还别说。
content_en:
"Baby apprentice."
"Master, please, come down the mountain."
Deep in the Kunlun Mountains, a woman with extremely beautiful appearance and temperament sat beside the bed.
Her plump figure was wrapped in a red palace skirt, her figure was as attractive as a mountain, and her beautiful face that could make all women jealous was full of pleading.
The man Su Qinghuan begged for was named Ye Fan. His head was resting on her slender legs, his eyes squinting in contentment.
"You forced me to go up the mountain, and now you want me to come down? There is no way."
Ye Fan's voice was lazily, and he raised his chin. Su Qinghuan peeled a grape very skillfully and stuffed it into Ye Fan's mouth. She felt regretful in her heart.
five years ago.
Su Qinghuan went down the mountain to practice, and unexpectedly discovered that Ye Fan was actually the legendary pure Yang body, and he had no inheritance from his master. He was an excellent piece of jade, and his future achievements were limitless.
It is impossible to expect that incompetent female disciple to shine.
So Su Qinghuan broke the Jade Girl Temple's rule of not accepting male disciples and wanted to accept Ye Fan as a closed disciple.
However, Ye Fan was indifferent and had no desire to live forever. He and his girlfriend were admitted to Yenching University and wanted to go to school.
The dignified pure yang body did not practice cultivation, but wasted time studying and falling in love. This made Su Qinghuan angry and forcibly kidnapped Ye Fan up the mountain.
Disobedient? beat!
Not practicing? beat!
Want to run? beat!
Judging from the results, Su Qinghuan did the right thing.
In just five years, Ye Fan, who was forced to practice hard, has reached the peak of his foundation and learned all the special skills passed down by many ancestors of Jade Girl Watch.
Feng shui divination, medical elixirs, talisman formations, flying swords, and objects, Ye Fan has reached the point where he is better than his master.
If the ancestors who were sleeping underground knew about it, they would definitely be moved to tears.
But...
This is also the beginning of a nightmare.
Ye Fan, who had respected his teacher for the past five years, turned into a villain who deceived his teacher and destroyed his ancestors, and ordered Su Qinghuan around.
In just one month, she, the master, had to serve tea and meals, sing and dance, and even warm the bed or take a bath. During this period, she would not be bullied...
Su Qinghuan had never suffered such grievance!
Escape, cannot escape.
Fight, can't beat.
Every time she resisted, she would be spanked. Su Qinghuan was filled with shame and anger every time she thought about this.
In order to get rid of Ye Fan, this evil disciple, Su Qinghuan followed the instructions every day and talked about the benefits of going down the mountain, but Ye Fan refused to leave.
In his words: In the Jade Girl Temple, there is a beautiful master who cares for her, and the emperor is nothing more than that.
Su Qinghuan was in her mid-thirties, which was the most charming stage for a woman. She was really afraid that Ye Fan couldn't resist the temptation, and if the window paper was broken...
The Jade Girl Temple might as well be renamed the Yunv Temple!
Su Qinghuan continued to persuade: "Ye Fan, actually you have a senior sister, Shen Yuluoyan is stunning in the world, you go down the mountain to find her."
"Senior sister, how can I be as fragrant as the master? When I warm the bed tonight, I will wear that red bellyband embroidered with carp. I like to eat fish."
"..."
Su Qinghuan's face was hot. Do you like to eat fish? I'm embarrassed to point it out to you!
She pretended to be pitiful and started to play the emotional card: "Ye Fan, I remember you said that you have a sister at home. She must be very worried about you after you have been on the mountain for five years."
"So I have to thank you even more, Master. Not only is my sister worried about me, but my girlfriend must also hate me. Maybe she is married to someone else and has children."
The more Ye Fan thought about it, the angrier he became. He pulled his master into his arms and gave him a spanking. Su Qinghuan was so hurt that she dared not speak out in anger.
Don't tell me yet.
